text_en: Therefore you have no excuse, whoever you are, when you judge others; for in passing judgment on another you condemn yourself, because you, the judge, are doing the very same things.
text_cn: 所以，人啊！你不论是谁，你判断人，必无可推诿，因为你判断别人，就是定你自己的罪，因为你这判断人的，正作着同样的事。

text_en: You say, “We know that God’s judgment on those who do such things is in accordance with truth. ”
text_cn: 我们知道：对于作这样事的人，天主必照真情判断。

text_en: Do you imagine, whoever you are, that when you judge those who do such things and yet do them yourself, you will escape the judgment of God?
text_cn: 人啊！你判断作这样事的人，你自己却作同样的事，你以为你能逃脱天主的审判吗？

text_en: Or do you despise the riches of his kindness and forbearance and patience? Do you not realize that God’s kindness is meant to lead you to repentance?
text_cn: 难道你不知道：天主的慈爱是愿引你悔改，而你竟轻视他丰厚的慈爱、宽容与忍耐吗？

text_en: But by your hard and impenitent heart you are storing up wrath for yourself on the day of wrath, when God’s righteous judgment will be revealed.
text_cn: 你固执而不愿悔改，只是为自己积蓄，在天主忿怒和显示他正义审判的那一天，向你所发的忿怒。

text_en: For he will repay according to each one’s deeds:
text_cn: 到那一天，“他要照每人的行为予以报应”：

text_en: to those who by patiently doing good seek for glory and honor and immortality, he will give eternal life;
text_cn: 凡恒心行善，寻求真荣、尊贵和不朽的人，赐以永生；

text_en: while for those who are self-seeking and who obey not the truth but wickedness, there will be wrath and fury.
text_cn: 凡固执于恶，不顺从真理，反顺从不义的人，报以忿怒和愤恨。

text_en: There will be anguish and distress for everyone who does evil, the Jew first and also the Greek,
text_cn: 患难和困苦必加于一切作恶的人，先是犹太人，后是希腊人；

text_en: but glory and honor and peace for everyone who does good, the Jew first and also the Greek.
text_cn: 光荣、尊贵以及平安，必加于一切行善的人，先是犹太人，后是希腊人，

text_en: For God shows no partiality.
text_cn: 因为天主决不顾情面。

text_en: All who have sinned apart from the law will also perish apart from the law, and all who have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
text_cn: 凡在法律之外犯了罪的人，也必要在法律之外丧亡；凡在法律之内犯了罪的人，也必要按照法律受审判，

text_en: For it is not the hearers of the law who are righteous in God’s sight, but the doers of the law who will be justified.
text_cn: 因为在天主前，并不是听法律的算为义人，而是实行法律的才称为义人。

text_en: When Gentiles, who do not possess the law, do instinctively what the law requires, these, though not having the law, are a law to themselves.
text_cn: 几时，没有法律的外邦人，顺着本性去行法律上的事，他们虽然没有法律，但自己对自己就是法律。

text_en: They show that what the law requires is written on their hearts, to which their own conscience also bears witness; and their conflicting thoughts will accuse or perhaps excuse them
text_cn: 如此证明了法律的精华已刻在他们的心上，他们的良心也为此作证，因为他们的思想有时在控告，有时在辩护；

text_en: on the day when, according to my gospel, God, through Jesus Christ, will judge the secret thoughts of all.
text_cn: 这事必要彰显在天主审判人隐秘行为的那天；依照我的福音，这审判是要藉耶稣基督而执行的。

text_en: But if you call yourself a Jew and rely on the law and boast of your relation to God
text_cn: 你既号称“犹太人”，又依仗法律，且拿天主来自夸；

text_en: and know his will and determine what is best because you are instructed in the law,
text_cn: 你既然认识他的旨意，又从法律中受了教训，能辨别是非，

text_en: and if you are sure that you are a guide to the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
text_cn: 又深信自己是瞎子的向导，是黑暗中人的光明，

text_en: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of children, having in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth,
text_cn: 是愚昧者的教师，是小孩子的师傅，有法律作知识和真理的标准；

text_en: you, then, that teach others, will you not teach yourself? While you preach against stealing, do you steal?
text_cn: 那么，你这教导别人的，就不教导你自己吗？为什么你宣讲不可偷盗，自己却去偷？

text_en: You that forbid adultery, do you commit adultery? You that abhor idols, do you rob temples?
text_cn: 说不可行奸淫，自己却去行奸淫？憎恶偶像，自己却去劫掠庙宇？

text_en: You that boast in the law, do you dishonor God by breaking the law?
text_cn: 以法律自夸，自己却因违反法律而使天主受侮辱？

text_en: For, as it is written, “The name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you. ”
text_cn: 正如经上所记载的：“天主的名在异民中因你们而受了亵渎。”

text_en: Circumcision indeed is of value if you obey the law; but if you break the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
text_cn: 如果你遵行法律，割损才有益；但如果你违犯法律，你虽受割损，仍等于未受割损。

text_en: So, if those who are uncircumcised keep the requirements of the law, will not their uncircumcision be regarded as circumcision?
text_cn: 反之，如果未受割损的人遵守了法律的规条，他虽未受割损，岂不算是受了割损吗？

text_en: Then those who are physically uncircumcised but keep the law will condemn you that have the written code and circumcision but break the law.
text_cn: 并且，那生来未受割损而全守法律的人，必要裁判你这具有法典，并受了割损而违犯法律的人。

text_en: For a person is not a Jew who is one outwardly, nor is true circumcision something external and physical.
text_cn: 外表上作犹太人的，并不是真犹太人；在外表上，肉身上的割损，也不是真割损；

text_en: Rather, a person is a Jew who is one inwardly, and real circumcision is a matter of the heart—it is spiritual and not literal. Such a person receives praise not from others but from God.
text_cn: 惟在内心做犹太人的，才是真犹太人。心中的割损，是出于神，并不是出于文字；这样的人受赞扬，不是来自人，而是来自天主。
